page.title: Planning Your Hosted Event Zero1vent
page.description: Decide the audience outcome, pick the right platform and production model, set timelines, run rehearsals, and convert attendees into owned audience for Zero1vent.
page.h1: What Should You Decide First About Hosted Event Zero1vent?
page.definition: Hosted event Zero1vent is a branded virtual or hybrid gathering produced on a chosen streaming platform with a dedicated crew handling run of show, speaker rehearsals, live moderation and backup streaming, delivering edited recordings and clips within forty-eight hours while converting live attention into an owned email and community audience.
page.quick_answer: Lock the audience outcome and format first, then choose a platform and production partner that match the scale, and schedule rehearsals on the real platform two to five days before going live.

sections.h2: What audience outcome and format must you lock first for Zero1vent?

blocks.p: Decide whether Zero1vent drives lead capture, community activation or product education, then pick a single format such as moderated webinar, multi-track summit or hybrid conference. The outcome dictates the platform tier, the production crew size and the follow-up workflow.

ul: Lead capture: gated registration, CRM tagging, sales handoff within twenty-four hours
Community activation: live chat, breakout rooms, post-event Discord or Circle invite
Product education: demo stations, Q&A panels, on-demand library with progress tracking

sections.h2: Which platform and production model fit Zero1vent's scale?

blocks.p: Match the expected attendee count and interaction level to one of three cost models: per-host licences sized by capacity, self-serve monthly plans, or annual enterprise contracts. The platform is not the production; someone still has to own the run of show, rehearse speakers and keep a backup stream ready. West Peek Productions produces virtual, hybrid and webinar events on the platform you choose and can help you choose it.

sections.h2: What timeline and staffing does Zero1vent need?

blocks.p: Plan six to eight weeks for a summit or hybrid event and three to four weeks for a webinar, assigning a show caller, speaker manager, moderator and platform operator for anything beyond a simple session. A summit needs six to eight weeks of management; a webinar three to four.

ul: Simple webinar: one producer handles platform, cues and recording
Summit or hybrid: show caller, speaker manager, moderator, platform operator
Hybrid addition: venue AV lead, on-site camera crew, stream encoder operator

sections.h2: How do you structure the run of show and rehearsals for Zero1vent?

blocks.p: Build a run of show with timed blocks, assign a live producer to cue speakers and lower thirds, and run one full rehearsal on the real platform two to five days before the event. A technical check sixty minutes before going live catches last-minute audio or bandwidth issues.

ol: Draft run of show with speaker slots, transitions, poll launches and buffer time
Distribute speaker brief with slide template, lower third specs and backup contact
Full rehearsal on the live platform two to five days out
Technical check sixty minutes before start: audio, video, screen share, backup stream
Go live with producer calling cues and moderator managing Q&A queue

sections.h2: What follow-up turns Zero1vent attendees into owned audience?

blocks.p: Send the edited replay within twenty-four to forty-eight hours, gate the recording behind an email capture, and enroll engaged attendees into a nurture sequence that moves them into your community platform. Owned audience beats rented reach: count email subscribers and community members, not only followers.

ul: Replay delivery: edited recording plus highlight clips under two minutes each
Email gate: landing page with form that tags source as Zero1vent
Nurture sequence: three emails over two weeks linking to community, resources, next event
Community invite: direct link to Discord, Slack or Circle with onboarding thread

faq.q: How much does a produced Zero1vent webinar cost?
faq.a: A moderated webinar production ranges from two thousand five hundred to seven thousand five hundred per production, covering run of show, speaker rehearsal, branded slides, live producer, Q&A moderation, backup stream and edited recording. Platform fees are separate.

faq.q: Can Zero1vent run on the platform we already use?
faq.a: Yes. Events are produced on the platform you already use such as Zoom Webinars, Microsoft Teams, ON24 or StreamYard. The production crew joins your instance and operates it for you.

faq.q: What is the minimum lead time for a Zero1vent summit?
faq.a: A summit or online conference needs six to eight weeks from kickoff to live. That covers intake, brief, production, review, approval, publishing and reporting stages with platform and venue AV locked before the agenda is final.

faq.q: Who owns the attendee data after Zero1vent?
faq.a: You own all registration and engagement data. The production partner delivers CSV exports and CRM-ready files; no data is retained by the production team after handoff.
